body:
Operator-approved, 2026-11-05.

zmux repo: wrapper, tests, VOCABULARY.md, overlay, the zp derivation. It is the tagged product.
~/flakes: takes zmux as an input, as it does panopticon, and applies the overlay.
~/.config/emacs: the only dl-zmx.el, replacing apps/dl-zmx.el under its CHR-009. emacs/ and DL_ZMX_ELISP leave this repo.
~/.config/zsh: za is deleted, since it would nest a second scope.

This settles a conflict in the store: plan-v0 shipped the plugin from this repo, d-surfaces placed it in the config.
title: Each piece lives where it is used
